# FROST GRUB2 theme
#
# Self-contained on purpose: only references background.png and
# frost-logo.png (both generated by branding/tools/generate_assets.py,
# committed alongside this file) — no 9-patch pixmap sets to maintain.
# Solid glacier-blue/ice colors stand in for styled button/progress-bar
# pixmaps, which keeps the whole theme reviewable as plain text + two
# small PNGs.
#
# "Frost Regular" is produced at install time by frost-branding.sh via
# `grub-mkfont --name="Frost Regular" ...` against a Nerd Font (Noto
# Sans Mono Nerd Font by default) — see BRANDING.README.md.

title-text: ""
desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-color: "#05080c"
terminal-font: "Frost Regular 16"

# FROST wordmark, centered a bit above the menu.
+ image {
    id = "frost_logo"
    file = "frost-logo.png"
    left = 50%-333
    top = 8%
    width = 665
    height = 244
}

+ boot_menu {
    left = 20%
    top = 46%
    width = 60%
    height = 34%

    item_font = "Frost Regular 16"
    item_color = "#7fb8e0"
    selected_item_color = "#eaf6ff"
    item_height = 34
    item_spacing = 6
    item_padding = 10

    icon_width = 0
    icon_height = 0

    scrollbar = false
}

# Countdown bar — flat glacier fill, no pixmap assets needed.
+ progress_bar {
    id = "__timeout__"
    left = 20%
    top = 84%
    width = 60%
    height = 18

    fg_color = "#3f8fc0"
    bg_color = "#0d1b26"

    show_text = true
    text_color = "#aad8f2"
    font = "Frost Regular 12"
    text = "@TIMEOUT_NOTIFICATION_MIDDLE@"
}

+ label {
    left = 0
    top = 96%
    width = 100%
    align = "center"
    color = "#3f5f74"
    font = "Frost Regular 12"
    text = "frost — minimalist Arch for full-stack devs"
}
